nodes.label: YOLOv8 Object Detector
nodes.rationale: Detects pedestrians and vehicles from camera video stream, accelerated by NVIDIA GPU or running on CPU.

nodes.label: Smart Parked Vehicle Rejection
nodes.rationale: Tracks center displacement across frames to classify stationary vehicles as parked within drift threshold, preventing gaze lock on parked street cars.

nodes.label: Halloween Window Projection Tracking
nodes.rationale: Project an eye into the round closet window on the front of the house with an outward-pointing camera so the eye follows cars or people as they pass by.

nodes.label: Configuration & Settings System
nodes.rationale: Centralized settings in src/config.py and settings.json controlling camera URLs, thresholds, display ports, and eyeball geometry.

nodes.label: Eye Display Stream Server (:8000)
nodes.rationale: HTTP service serving the projected eye via snapshot polling or MJPEG stream to Android TV / Mi Box.

nodes.label: Eye Type Variations
nodes.rationale: Multiple procedural and sprite eye styles including human, monster, zombie, dragon, snake, spider, bug, creepy figure, joker, 3D skull, dancing skeleton, UGA logo.

nodes.label: Phone IP Webcam Stream
nodes.rationale: Android phone running IP Webcam app aimed outside through the window serves as low-latency wireless camera feed over Wi-Fi.

nodes.label: Procedural Eyeball Engine
nodes.rationale: Renders photorealistic eye with spherical shading, upper eyelid shadow, dynamic blood vessels, involuntary micro-blinks, pupil dilation, and idle animations.

nodes.label: Round Window Projection Mapping
nodes.rationale: Projects animated eyeball onto round closet window with strict circular mask and solid black background to eliminate light bleed.

nodes.label: Web Tuning Dashboard (:8090)
nodes.rationale: Provides live camera tracking overlay, eye preview, and real-time parameter tuning sliders without restarting services.

nodes.label: Android TV Snapshot Polling Viewer
nodes.rationale: Android TV WebViews frequently freeze or drop raw multipart MJPEG streams; polling /snapshot JPEG frames ensures reliable playback.

nodes.label: Perspective-Correct Gaze Mirroring
nodes.rationale: Horizontal eye deflection is inverted so from the perspective of an outside observer looking into the window, the eye looks directly toward the target.

nodes.label: Zero-Lag Camera Reader
nodes.rationale: OpenCV FFmpeg default capture buffers network video. A background worker thread continuously pulls and discards stale buffer frames using zero-delay demux flags to maintain real-time tracking latency.
